title: HB875 (2017 Regular): Firearms - Handgun Qualification License - Firearms Safety Training

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2017RS/bills/hb/hb0875f.pdf)
provenance.note: first reader: bill as filed; no enrolled text read; no passage vote recorded. The bill also deletes, in [brackets], the firearms orientation component (shooting demonstration) from the handgun qualification license training course in § 5-117.1(d); only the added regulation sentence is quoted.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-117.1(d)(2)): (2) THE SECRETARY SHALL ADOPT REGULATIONS THAT ALLOW AN APPLICANT TO RECEIVE ONLINE ALL NECESSARY INSTRUCTION FROM THE FIREARMS SAFETY TRAINING COURSE DESCRIBED IN PARAGRAPH (1)(III) OF THIS SUBSECTION.
